drafts.draft_en:
A UK lender just launched a 99% mortgage for first-time buyers. 1% down.

Here's the problem: with 1% equity, a 2% price dip puts you underwater on day one.

That's why I buy at a discount. Purchase plus repairs at or under 65% of ARV.

Equity on day one is the only safety net I trust.
drafts.pattern: JUST IN 99%/1%-deposit mortgage wave (@Kalshi_Finance 2.27M, @Polymarket 1.13M, @NoLimitGains 474k) + Bar's 65% rule. Answers the '2008 again' replies with a calm investor rule.
drafts.video_tip: 30s talking head with the headline on screen. Show two bars: '1% equity' vs '35% equity'. Say 'A 2% dip wipes out the first buyer. It barely touches the second.' Captions burned in.

drafts.draft_en:
A homeowner's property tax bill jumped 28% and the video went viral.

Investors shouldn't be surprised by that. Taxes are a line item.

Before I make an offer in Montgomery, Bucks or Delaware County, I pull the current tax bill and run the numbers as if it goes up.

If the deal only works at today's tax number, it doesn't work.
drafts.pattern: Property-tax outrage (@WallStreetApes 406k, @GuntherEagleman 47k) turned into an underwriting lesson. Stays non-political: taxes as a deal input, not a policy fight.
drafts.video_tip: Screen-record a public county tax lookup (no real owner's name), circle the annual tax, then plug it into a simple deal sheet with +20% taxes. 'Still works? Make the offer. Doesn't? Walk.'

drafts.draft_en:
Hey @grok, a couple near Philadelphia earns $160K combined.

Option A: buy a $750K house with 20% down.
Option B: buy a $350K house and a $200K duplex, renting one side.

Which usually builds more wealth over 10 years?

Show the math. Be honest.
drafts.pattern: Income-vs-lifestyle math (@JGWorldThoughts 408k, @annbauerwriter 946k) + Grok ask with real numbers (@notes_from_x +106k in a day). Hypothetical numbers, educational; let Grok answer, then quote-post the investor's take.
drafts.video_tip: Split screen: dream house on the left, rowhome + duplex on the right. Type the question, cut to Grok's answer, then 20s selfie: 'Grok left out vacancy and repairs. Here's the real version.'
